Index helpers

Source: R/index.R
anndata-index.Rd

Internal helpers that turn an R index into positions along one axis. Indices use R semantics, a deliberate deviation from Python: positive integers are 1-based positions (repeats and reordering allowed), negative integers exclude positions, logical vectors must have the length of the axis and character vectors match names, taking the first match. Zero, NA, unknown names, out-of-range positions and mixed signs raise an anndata_index_error.

Usage

normalize_index(i, names, what, call = rlang::caller_env())

subset_frame(df, idx = NULL)

Arguments

i

An index, or NULL to keep the whole axis.

names

The names along the axis.

what

Description of the axis used in error messages.

call

The call reported by errors.

df

A DataFrame or data.frame.

idx

Integer positions, or NULL to keep every row.

Deviations from Python

The indices above. See vignette("deviations") for the full list.
